query:
SELECT postid                    AS "postid!",
                   userid                    AS "userid!",
                   COALESCE(channelid, '')   AS "channelid!",
                   COALESCE(acknowledgedat, 0) AS "acknowledgedat!",
                   remoteid
              FROM postacknowledgements
             WHERE postid = $1 AND userid = $2 AND acknowledgedat <> 0
